facts.text: John described feeling at peace while hiking near a river surrounded by rocks.

evidence.quote: The sound of that river was so soothing, I felt so at peace surrounded by those rocks. It was like nature was telling me to stop and admire its beauty.

facts.text: John mentioned that nature puts him in a great mood and always gets him energized.

evidence.quote: Nature puts me in a great mood and always gets me energized!

facts.text: John stated that his team has been working hard and achieving their goals on the court.

evidence.quote: Things have been going great on the court. We've been putting in a lot of work and achieving our goals, which is awesome.

facts.text: John mentioned that his team gave it their all during last week's scrimmage and is confident in their growth.

evidence.quote: We gave it our all during last week's scrimmage. It's amazing to see our team's growth. We know it won't be easy, but it'll be worth it when we see the results.
